content: Bākharzī, Jāmī's hagiographer, reports Jāmī's dim view of Sharaf al-Dīn and Ṣāʾin al-Dīn: Yazdī could speak of the theory and vocabulary of Sufism but not convincingly, yet was held by contemporaries the most all-encompassing of scholars, while he himself said all his knowledge was an instance of the benevolence of Khwāja Ṣāʾin al-Dīn Turka and praised him constantly. MK notes the book was checked and approved by Jāmī himself (Binbaş).
refers_to_primary: ʿAbd al-Vāsiʿ Niẓāmī Bākharzī, Maqāmāt-i Jāmī, 107 (hostile reporter of Jāmī's opinion)
